channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Coby White | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Coby White from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brandon Miller on Coby White
item.description:
“Being there for our teammates, showing up for events like this … I went to Grant’s golf tournament this year, been to Grant’s camp this year, plan on going to Coby White’s camp. It’s just showing up for the guys. That’s all we can ask for.“We see them every day throughout the season, but showing up for stuff and their needs is kind of important to them as a player.”

Brandon Miller on Coby White, Aug 28, 2026. Source: Charlotte Observer.

item.title: Noa Essengue on Ayo Dosunmu, Coby White
item.description:
“Oh yes, and I would say first of all the two who helped me a lot at the time of my injury were Coby White and Ayo Dosunmu. Because it is two guys who went through this operation too. So talking with them, talking about how rehabilitation was, how long it takes, if it was hard to come back afterwards, for this injury, they helped me a lot.”

Noa Essengue on Ayo Dosunmu, Coby White, Jun 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Coby White
item.description:
KC Johnson:Zach LaVine on Coby White dunk:

“We had a running joke like, somebody has to try him. I was trying to but it didn’t work out. So I’m happy and I’m a little envious because Coby has two dunks on the year. One of them is on Wemby. So, kudos.”

Zach LaVine on Coby White, Jan 7, 2025. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Coby White
item.description:
Julia Poe:DeMar DeRozan on whether Coby White should get the ball in his hands for crucial end-of-game shots:

“No doubt. If he looked at me and said he wanted it, no problem.”

DeMar DeRozan on Coby White, Jan 23, 2024. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Coby White
item.description:
Rob Schaefer:Arturas Karnisovas on Coby White’s recovery from shoulder injury:

“He’s doing great. He’s recovering. He’s going through stages. Spirits are up.”

Arturas Karnisovas on Coby White, Jul 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Billy Donovan, Zach LaVine, Coby White
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Doc Rivers on the Chicago Bulls:

“Zach LaVine has been special all year. Coby White is going to be a good player. You can see some of Billy Donovan’s stuff, a lot of good movement. I think he’s been really good for LaVine because of the movement he runs. They’re going to be ok.”

Doc Rivers on Billy Donovan, Zach LaVine, Coby White, Feb 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Coby White
item.description:
KC Johnson:Billy Donovan on Coby White:

“It’s not always going to be about how well he’s playing but how well the group is playing. And I think that’s his maturation, that’s the process he has to go through in terms of understanding that he has to be a connector.”

Billy Donovan on Coby White, Dec 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Coby White
item.description:
KC Johnson:Zach LaVine on Coby White:

“I’m excited to play with him. Obviously, I think we can be a dynamic duo.”

Zach LaVine on Coby White, Mar 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.
